analysis_role: secondary exploratory completion of the core method because LOSO CB-SF was absent from the parent freeze
base_oof_reconstruction: retrain each inner model to the independently selected epoch stored by clean DASF; no outer-test label or prediction is used
calibration: none beyond the OOF logistic meta-stacker
claim_scope: empirical risk-aware soft fusion; no formal risk control, safety or no-regret guarantee
final_order: form five-seed median always_nn and always_fuse window probabilities
fit one CB-SF gate using only inner cross-fitted rows from the outer-training participants
predict one soft weight for the held-out participant from label-free target diagnostics
gate_target: recording accuracy benefit of cross-fitted always_fuse minus cross-fitted always_nn
inner_split: complete participant LOSO over the 14 outer-training participants
meta_probability_aggregation: per-recording geometric mean within seed, followed by per-class median across five seeds

meta_stacker.features: logits of always_nn, rf and extra_trees OOF probabilities
meta_stacker.requirement: the held meta-participant is excluded when its fusion probability is generated
